$comment: Execution baseline reviewed on 2026-09-16 from complete remediation main results, passing focused corrections, and the passing isolated stage. Historical reference: verify run 34763333121 at commit 26cd39856fd8a5580c77025ee0ec95732572045d.

Only assertions with passed/failed status and suites with completed assertions count. Pending/todo tests require an exact, reasoned intentionalSkips entry; a quarantine never excuses a suite failing to execute.

Reviewed Windows main scope is 763 suites and 6874 tests; portable minima subtract one suite and five Windows-only tests, which have explicit Unix intentionalSkips below. Isolated executed 9 suites and 101 tests. Browser capture, snapshot Git integration and memory lifecycle run in the isolated stage. All nine quarantines are retired; see docs/audits/quarantine-status.md for evidence.
Update minima only after a reviewed passing gate. Do not approve a new skip solely to silence a regression.
